## Link your marketing with Bitly

Bitly makes it easy to create, share, and track short links and QR Codes. Find what’s resonating and scale it into bigger reach, more clicks, and more sales.

[Get started for free](https://bitly.com/pages/pricing/)

## Life at Bitly

For over a decade, we’ve been the point of connection for sharers of digital information and their audiences. We pride ourselves in being a platform that is a catalyst for connections and we carry that commitment across everything we do.

![](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/21205108/about_hero_img-animated.svg)

01![](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/23194159/catalyst_value_icon.svg)

Be a catalyst

As an innovative technology company, we build products to be catalysts for connection and encourage our team to be catalysts for meaningful impact both at work and in the world.

02![](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/23194212/dei-pillars_community-partnerships.svg)

Take ownership

In our highly collaborative culture, individual accountability is critical. While depending on each other to solve our customers’ most challenging problems, we celebrate the wins and failures together.

03![](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/23194209/dei_value_icon.svg)

Champion inclusion

Our products bring people together across backgrounds and abilities. We’re built on the belief that inclusion drives progress—and that our differences make us stronger. Everyone deserves the opportunity to belong, contribute, and thrive.

04![](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/23194226/have-fun_value_icon.svg)

Have fun

Building a memorable work experience comes both through driving meaningful impact while also not taking ourselves too seriously. We work hard but that doesn’t mean we don’t have fun.

05![](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/23194232/integrity_value_icon.svg)

Show integrity

We don’t cut corners. We don’t look for the easy way out. We approach every day with a shared mindset – let’s do the right thing, even if it’s the harder thing.

## Inclusion at Bitly

Creating human connection starts with a culture of inclusion, accessibility, and continuous learning. These values are part of who we are—and we’re committed to making Bitly an even better place to work by growing in each of these areas.

[Learn more](https://bitly.com/pages/inclusion/)

![](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/16231218/inclusive-people_img%402x-768x530-1.png)

![Peter Krivkovich](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/16231032/peter-k.png)

Peter KrivkovichChief Executive Officer

Peter is Bitly’s CEO, where he leads the company’s strategic vision, innovation roadmap, and growth initiatives. Prior to this role, Peter served as the company’s Chief Financial Officer, where he played a critical role in scaling the business, optimizing operations, and building a strong foundation for sustainable growth.

Prior to joining Bitly, Peter was the Co-Founder, CFO and former CEO of NextRoll.

[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pkrivkovich/)

![Tara Robertson](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/16231032/tara-r.png)

Tara RobertsonChief Commercial Officer

Tara Robertson is Bitly’s Chief Commercial Officer. She manages all marketing, sales, and customer success matters for the company–creating and communicating value to millions of customers.

Before Bitly, Tara held roles at Teamwork, Sprout Social Inc. and Hotjar.

[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/taraerobertson/)

![Kelsey Stevenson](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/16231032/kelsey-s.png)

Kelsey StevensonChief Product Officer

Kelsey is Bitly’s Chief Product Officer. She’s focused on setting the product vision, creating a product strategy aligned with Bitly’s company goals and delivering product solutions that solve customer pain points.

Prior to joining Bitly, Kelsey led product teams at Cloud Elements and spent time as a product management consultant at Slalom.

[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kelsey-stevenson-10310037/)

![Matt Young](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/16231031/matt_y.png)

Matt YoungChief Technology Officer

Matt is Bitly’s Chief Technology Officer, where he leads the Engineering and Data organizations, ensuring consistent high-quality delivery and sustainable long-term growth across the company’s platforms and services.

Before Bitly, Matt served as Chief Executive Officer at UserVoice, where he guided product direction, team execution, and strategic growth for the customer feedback and engagement platform.

[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mattcyoung/)

![Kelly Zitzmann](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/16231024/Kelly-Zitzmann-headshot.png)

Kelly ZitzmannChief Legal & Administrative Officer

Kelly is Bitly’s Chief Legal & Administrative Officer. She oversees the Legal, People and IT teams at Bitly. Kelly is responsible for ensuring that Bitly is an amazing place to work for our Bitizens, and for global compliance matters, including protecting the safety of our platform and its users.

Before joining Bitly, Kelly was the Chief Legal Officer at Smartly.io and GC at Axiom.

[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kelly-c-zitzmann-42778a122/)

![Jerome Alabado](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/16231024/Jerome-Alabado.jpg)

Jerome AlabadoVP, Financial Planning & Analysis

Jerome is Bitly’s VP of Financial Planning and Analysis. He is focused on financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and key business metric analysis that support Bitly’s growth and profitability objectives.

Before Bitly, Jerome held leadership roles at public companies and high-growth startups, most recently as VP of Finance at ActiveCampaign.

[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeromealabado/)

![Manu Jain](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/16231024/Manu-Jain.png)

Manu JainVP, Data

Manu is Bitly’s VP of Data. He is responsible for building Bitly’s comprehensive data platform that empowers the company with insights, fuels innovation, enhances user experience, and helps chart new pathways.

Before Bitly, Manu held leadership roles in the data and analytics space at PayPal, Wayfair, Meta and McKinsey.

[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/manujain/)

![Shannon Jankun](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/16231024/Shannon-Jankun.png)

Shannon JankunVP, Human Resources

Shannon is Bitly’s VP of Human Resources. She is focused on talent management, employee relations, and organizational development initiatives in support of an engaged, inclusive and high-performing culture.

Before Bitly, Shannon held progressive HR roles, most recently at Ahold Delhaize, with a focus on strategic business partnering.

[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shannon-jankun-15976662/)

![Oran Mizrahi](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/16231024/Oran-Mizrahi.png)

Oran MizrahiVP, Finance

Oran is Bitly’s VP of Finance. She oversees all aspects of finance and is responsible for scaling the company’s global finance organization to foster Bitly’s growth.

Before Bitly, Oran held roles at LivePerson and Ernst and Young.

[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/oran-mizrahi-86640299/)

![Sam Oh](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/16231023/Sam-Oh.png)

Sam OhVP, Acquisition

Sam is Bitly’s VP of Acquisition. He focuses on driving revenue by connecting the value of our platform and products to our current and new customers.

Before Bitly, Sam served marketing teams at Seismic, Lessonly, and Craftsy.

[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sam-oh-5026803/)

![Luke Reynebeau](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/16231023/Luke-Reynebeau.png)

Luke ReynebeauVP, Customer & Retention Marketing

Luke is Bitly’s VP of Customer and Retention Marketing. His focus is on user engagement programs, partner and ecosystem marketing and customer marketing initiatives aligned to both customer experience and revenue goals.

Prior to joining Bitly, Luke worked in marketing leadership roles in SaaS scale-ups and startups, including overseeing partner and customer marketing at Sprout Social during its growth from startup to IPO.

[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lukereynebeau/)

![Michael Richman](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/16231023/Michael-Richman.png)

Michael RichmanVP, Engineering

Michael is Bitly’s VP of Engineering focused on Platform & Infrastructure. He oversees teams responsible for stability, scalability, distributed systems, modernization, and Trust & Safety. Michael joined Bitly in 2010 to build out the first paid offering and has led both Platform and Application Development teams.

Prior to Bitly, Michael rose through the engineering ranks at AOL where he worked on a variety of properties including AIM, MapQuest, and AOL.com.

[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/michael-richman-b7807b2/)

![Raphael Syed](https://mkt-bitly-media.qrcg.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/16231023/Raphael-Syed.png)

Raphael SyedVP, Engineering

Rapha is Bitly’s VP of Engineering. He is focused on building reliable, scalable, and secure systems for Bitly customers and users. He works to enhance technical and process efficiency, and is involved in leading the security and compliance endeavors from an engineering viewpoint.

Before joining Bitly, he was responsible for managing the engineering org at Chronext, a prominent marketplace for luxury watch trading.

[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/raphael-syed-230369122/)
